{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for: completed orders AND loyal customers
filtered = sales[
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal')
]

# Check for QA orders in the filtered set
qa_in_filtered = filtered[filtered['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders in filtered set: {len(qa_in_filtered)}")"}
